comment: Per-directory deletion rules for archive_rotate.py --retention (see docs/research_lab/data_catalogue/RETENTION.md). A server file is only ever removed if it is in a verified release with an identical sha256; these rules only say how old it must be and which small files stay. Directories without a rule are never deleted.
